[[Long Arm of the Law]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[scythe]] dropped by [[Peacekeeper Sibyl]]s and [[White Mantle Devotee]]s in [[Kryta]] during the [[War in Kryta]].

==Stats==
:Slashing Dmg: 9-41 (Requires 9 [[Scythe Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Enchantment|Enchanted]])
:Energy on hit +1
:Energy regeneration -1
:[[Enchantment]]s last 20% longer
Two Handed
==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as as the [[Razorclaw Scythe]].
